page.layout: One page of running text in a single justified column, with the running head centred at the top. No marginal notes, no page number, no footnotes. The catchword sits at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: legisse,uel si legerit,perfunctorié legisse, uel denique non intellexisse uideatur. Sic artis medendi fundamenta ab eo nimium audacter,nec dicam imperitè coercitur,medicationisq; certissimæ summa affectur confusio . Iftud quidem aduersus hos grauissimos authores fieri,nec patrouum[?],qui uoculam Fernelio reponeret inueniri semper,ut debui,uehementer dolui . At in nobilissima arte pro ueritate uanitatem haberi prudentissimis medendi legibus stolidam temeritatem substitui: denique pro arte periculum affumi, ita ægrè tuli, ut ab eo tempore nō coquicuerim[?] donec his meis exercitationibus,quasi signo dato excitarem uel quosdam ex multis, qui non Hippocratis, aut Galeni, sed ueritatis ipsius patrocini-um suscipercent. Hæc igitur nobis progymnasmata fuc-riunt,quæ fiunt insignis alicuius uictoriæ prænuntia,cuius gloriam alijs libentisimè concedo. Quicquid fanè ago,eo finè ago, ut alijs ad maiora uiam planiorem faciam, coq; animo ab omnibus, qui ista legent acceptum iri[?] confido. Equidem cum de scriptis meis nō magnopere laborare soleam,laterecq; semper concupiuerim,tamen hoc scriptū meum cupio, & legi,& ad exteros peruenire,ut extet aliquod testimonium amoris erga præclaros illos medicinæ authores mei. Ac ne quis, forte eorum[?],qui nimia facilitate, uel potius simplicitate in legendis aliorum scriptis decipi se patiantur, existimet me uel contradicendi studio, uel ambitiosa cupiditate ad hæc scribenda, impulsum uenisse, Deum immortalem testor nihil mihi tale in mentem incidisse, nihilq;

page.notes: Long s is printed as a plain s throughout (e.g. "fed" = sed, "fubftitui" = substitui, "ftudio" = studio). The first word of the page continues the sentence from the previous page. "trouum" at the start of the sixth line is uncertain and is marked [?]. "coquicuerim" is uncertain and is marked [?]. The word "fuc-riunt" at the line end is a printed hyphenated word and is read as printed; the reading is uncertain. The letters before "q;" in "coq;" and "laterecq;" are uncertain. "iri" before "confido" is uncertain. The word "eorum" at the start of the line that begins "corum,qui" is read as "eorum" with uncertainty. The catchword "uerius" is read from a faint "ucrius" and may be misprinted. The "q" symbols for -que are written as "q;" as the rules require. No page number or signature is printed.
